description: Returns the static reference data an agent needs to build valid searches and read responses without guessing: the numeric category ids and their keys/English names (use these for search's category filter), the condition codes, the list of supported ISO currency codes and the fallback default currency (search and product tools default to the caller's own currency when known), the payment- and shipment-method codes, the available sort options, the max search page size, and policy URLs (AI policy, OpenAPI spec). The photo limit per listing depends on the seller's plan -- see sellers.status max_images. Read-only, no authentication required. Safe to call once and cache for the session.
name: marketplace.info

default_currency.description: Last-resort fallback only, used when the caller's currency can't be determined. A signed-in caller gets prices in their own currency (sellers.status.currency); an anonymous one in a currency derived like on the website (country, then browser language).

title: Get Resollo marketplace taxonomy and metadata
